subject: Incident summary: StellarBank service degradation (Apr 2) - RCA & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: Trey Sullivan <trey@stellarbank.com>, Amanda Cho <amanda.cho@stellarbank.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.inference>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.inference>
Date: 2027-04-03T09:18:00Z
Subject: Incident summary: StellarBank service degradation (Apr 2) - RCA & next steps

Hi Trey / Amanda,

Thank you again for your patience while we completed our investigation into the degradation you experienced on Apr 2 between 03:10–03:42 UTC. Attached is a concise RCA and our committed mitigation plan. High level: a software bug in an autoscaling path allowed an inconsistent kernel selection that caused a backlog of inference requests under a specific burst pattern. That backlog cascaded into higher-than-expected queuing and token latency for ~32 minutes for traffic routed to the us-west-2 pool.

What we are sending here: 1) a two-page RCA summary (attached) outlining the sequence of events and root cause, 2) a mitigation timeline with owners and verification checkpoints (attached), and 3) a set of immediate compensatory actions we've already completed for your account.

Immediate actions already taken:
- Reverted the autoscaler policy that matched your dedicated pool to the safe baseline at 03:44 UTC.
- Deployed a hotfix to the kernel-selection logic at 04:10 UTC.
- Backfilled the KV cache where entries were evicted incorrectly; verification run completed at 05:02 UTC.

Planned next steps (owners & ETA in the attached sheet):
- Formal regression test and load-pattern simulation (Dylan) — complete by 2027-04-06
- Canary the new autoscaler policy across a subset of customers (Sergio) — start 2027-04-07
- Post-deployment verification and automated alert tuning (Marissa) — complete by 2027-04-09

We recommend a 30-minute joint verification call next week to walk through the mitigation tests and your internal acceptance steps. Proposed windows attached. Please let us know which you prefer.

Files attached: 20270403-stellarbank-rca.pdf (RCA summary), starlight-mitigation-timeline.xlsx (owners & verification).

Apologies again for the impact; we take incidents like this seriously and are committed to preventing recurrence.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference
+1 (415) 555-0123

Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.inference>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.inference>, legal@stellarbank.com
Date: 2027-04-04T08:33:00Z
Subject: Re: Incident summary: StellarBank service degradation (Apr 2) - RCA & next steps

Amanda — good questions, and thank you for looping legal. Short answers below; Dylan and I included the verification notes.

1) Data integrity / PII: No customer data was exfiltrated. There were transient request failures and some client-side retries; payloads were not logged in plaintext by the affected path. We performed a scope review of all logs generated by the autoscaler and kernel-selection components and found no evidence of injected outbound requests or data transfer beyond normal egress to your configured endpoints. Legal: if you want a signed attestation, we can produce a short statement for your records — see related_links for a draft template.

2) KV cache backfill validation: Dylan ran an itemized verification run comparing pre-incident snapshots to the post-backfill state for a randomized sample of 5% of keys and a full checksum pass for keys tagged as session-critical for StellarBank. The randomized sample matched 100%; the session-critical set matched checksums after rehydration. Dylan's note: full list of affected key namespaces is in the attached sheet under "verification_notes".

We will include a brief, legally-oriented summary for your counsel and can run any additional verification you require.

Regarding the verification call — we can do 2027-04-07 at 16:00 PDT (23:00 UTC) or 2027-04-08 at 09:30 PDT (16:30 UTC). Please confirm which you prefer; we'll send a calendar invite with the post-deployment test plan.

Thanks,

Marissa
Head of Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.inference>
To: Amanda Cho <amanda.cho@stellarbank.com>, Trey Sullivan <trey@stellarbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.inference>
Date: 2027-04-05T15:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Incident summary: StellarBank service degradation (Apr 2) - RCA & next steps

Amanda / Trey — quick technical confirmation from the ops side:
- Root cause: a race condition in kernel selection triggered when concurrent slot reassignments overlapped with an autoscaler burst window. The code path has been patched (commit 9f3b2c) and peer-reviewed; unit and integration tests added.
- Scope: requests that experienced elevated latency are fully reprocessed where idempotency keys were provided. For any non-idempotent operations we flagged (none in your traffic), we will coordinate replay/compensation if you prefer — currently we have no evidence of partial writes to your backend.
- Validation: checksum verification for session namespaces and 5% randomized key sampling completed; logs and checksums are in the attached verification tab.

If you want us to run a targeted replay for a specific time window against a staging copy of your backend, we can do that as a binding test during the verification call.

I'll prepare a short, signed tech note for your records and post it to the Drive link once ready.

-Dylan
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
dylan.brooks@redwood.inference
